narration: You’ve probably heard someone say, “I built this app without coding.” But that isn’t really what happened.
onScreenText: I BUILT THIS APP WITHOUT CODING.
captionText: I built this app without coding.
voiceDirection: Start with a crisp, curious hook. Slight emphasis on “without coding,” then settle.

narration: In 2025, Andrej Karpathy coined “vibe coding” for a loose way of building where you describe what you want, let the AI write the code, run it, feed errors back, and keep moving—sometimes without really reading the code.
captionText: Describe it. Run it. Feed errors back.
voiceDirection: Informative and measured. Keep the process list rhythmic but not rushed.

narration: Today, people use the phrase more broadly, but the useful idea is simple: your job moves up a level.
onScreenText: YOUR ROLE MOVES UP A LEVEL
captionText: Your job moves up a level.
voiceDirection: Calm explanatory delivery. Give “moves up a level” a small deliberate emphasis.

narration: Instead of typing every line, you describe the intent. The AI proposes a change.
captionText: Describe the intent. Let AI propose the change.
voiceDirection: Clear and practical. Brief pause between the human action and the AI action.

narration: You run it. You inspect what happened. Then you correct the direction.
captionText: Run it. Inspect it. Correct the direction.
voiceDirection: Use three clean beats: run, inspect, correct. Do not sound dramatic.

narration: That loop can be incredibly fast. But speed doesn’t remove responsibility.
voiceDirection: Slightly firmer on the second sentence. Responsibility is the key word.

narration: The AI can execute. You still decide what should exist, whether the result is correct, and whether the thing is safe enough to ship.
onScreenText: AI: EXECUTE • YOU: DECIDE / VERIFY / OWN
captionText: AI executes. You decide, verify, and own.
voiceDirection: Confident and grounded. Contrast “AI can execute” with “You still decide” without sounding preachy.

narration: So vibe coding isn’t magic, and it isn’t “no coding.” It’s building software through direction, iteration, and judgment. Next, I’ll show you what an AI coding agent is actually doing behind the scenes.
voiceDirection: Decisive summary, then a lighter forward-looking tone for the next-episode line.
